beats.prose:
The gate opened with a sound like a chair being moved across a kitchen floor.

Nell brought seedlings. Samir brought a kettle, though there was nowhere to plug it in. Jo brought nothing at all and stood looking at the weeds.

“Well,” Nell said, setting down her tray. “There’s room.”
